en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate Islamic religious complex with domes and a tall minaret. The central building bears rich geometric decoration and a large ribbed dome, identified on the card as the Mausoleum of Nabi Daniel. In the foreground, people in traditional clothing stand and sit along a low wall and near an arched entrance. Printed French captions and a publisher credit appear on the image margins.
